usedFor: Shopify holds the checkout and Freshdesk holds the support desk. “Abandoned Checkout” can run “Create a Contact”, so a shopper who stalled already has a record if they write in.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create a Contact” in Freshdesk
bestTemplate.why: It fires only when the shopper entered an email or phone and left, so the contact it creates is someone who showed intent.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so contacts arrive on a schedule. Contacts are made for every abandoner, so the helpdesk list can grow quickly.
